title: Element 115 used to amplify gravity
summary: Steve Coburn tells of Element 115 used to amplify gravity, about unspecified at unspecified, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: uh they according to Bob Lazar, they didn't I don't remember him telling me this, but according to Bob Lazar, they also use element 115 sometimes to amplify the the gravitational effect.

plain: A guest named Steve Coburn, on Jesse Michels's podcast, repeats a claim from a man named Bob Lazar about "element 115", a very heavy chemical element Lazar has linked to alien craft. Coburn says that, according to Lazar, the element was sometimes used to amplify gravity's effect, though Coburn adds he does not remember Lazar telling him this personally. If true, it would mean someone had learned to control gravity using this material.
